description: This Java test class, named AmqpValidatorTest, contains unit tests for the AmqpValidator class, specifically testing validation logic for messaging sources and targets in an AMQP context within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: AmqpValidatorTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for verifying the correctness and immutability of AmqpValidator functionalities in various scenarios including validation of headers, enforcement, placeholders, and target address placeholders.

methods.name: testImmutability
methods.description: Tests that the AmqpValidator class is immutable, ensuring thread safety and predictable behavior.

methods.name: testValidationOfEnforcement
methods.description: Validates proper handling of enforcement rules within the source configuration.

methods.name: testValidHeaderMapping
methods.description: Checks that valid header mappings are accepted without errors.

methods.name: testInvalidHeaderMappingThrowsException
methods.description: Ensures that invalid header mappings, especially with unresolved placeholders, throw ConnectionConfigurationInvalidException.

methods.name: testInvalidInputThrowsException
methods.description: Verifies that enforcement with invalid placeholders raises the appropriate exception.

methods.name: testInvalidMatcherThrowsException
methods.description: Checks for proper exception when header matchers are invalid or unresolved.

methods.name: testValidMatchers
methods.description: Ensures valid matchers in enforcement are accepted.

methods.name: testValidPlaceholdersInTargetAddress
methods.description: Tests that placeholders within the target address are correctly validated.

methods.name: newSourceBuilder
methods.description: Helper method to create a new SourceBuilder with preset address and authorization context.
